description: Bike Racks is a dataset listed in Ballarat open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by City of Ballarat. This dataset describes the type and location of bike racks located in Ballarat. The information was collected as the bike racks were constructed. The intended use of the information is to inform the public of the locations of Ballarat's bike racks. The dataset is typically updated monthly on an automated schedule. Coverage: Ballarat, Victoria. The portal files it under Roads & Planning, Transport. Its keywords are bike, bicycle, racks. The portal shows 184 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 3 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/au/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ballarat-vic-gov-au-portal.
